title: Exact equivariant transport commutes with the derived conjugation action
statement: Let $C,D$ be abelian categories with additive autoequivalences $F,G$, with ordinary derived categories of both underlying and fixed-pair categories [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Let $L:C\to D$ be additive and exact and let $e:L\circ G\simeq F\circ L$ in Lean functor-composition order. Put $J=D(\operatorname{mapOfNatIso}(e))$ and $H=D(L)$ [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. For all $M,N\in D(C^F)$, every $r\in\mathbf Z$, and every $u\in V^r_{M,N}$, the prescribed transport of [def-sf-cyclic-derived-hom-data] satisfies $\operatorname{tr}^r(T^r(u))=T^r(\operatorname{tr}^r(u))$. The transport uses exactly cyclicDerivedExactForgetComparison and the canonical shift isomorphisms; no cohomological boundedness or Grothendieck hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Localize the ordinary fixed-pair structure square. Write U=D(forget F), V=D(forget G), J=D(mapOfNatIso e), H=D(L), P=D(F), R=D(G), alpha=cyclicDerivedExactForgetComparison, and beta=(D(LG) comparison inverse) followed by D(e) followed by the D(FL) comparison. The private structure_fac and square_fac lemmas compute these comparisons on Q of complexes from mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_hom_app_factors. Form the two natural transformations in the structure square and apply Localization.natTrans_ext. Cancel the invertible factors of U and L. Naturality of beta and of the factorization maps reduces the equality to e at the underlying complex followed by L of the structure, which equals the transported structure degree by degree by the definition of mapOfNatIso. This proves R(alpha_M) beta_(UM) H(theta_M)=theta_(JM) alpha_M for every derived object M (private action_structure).

proof.text: Apply the private conjugation_transport lemma, proved for arbitrary categories with shifts. At M, multiply the structure equation by the inverse structure maps to get alpha_M H(theta_M inverse)=theta_(JM) inverse R(alpha_M) beta_(UM). At N, multiply by the inverses of alpha and R(alpha) to get beta_(UN) H(theta_N) alpha_N inverse=R(alpha_N inverse) theta_(JN). Expand the two conjugations. Naturality of beta moves H(P(u)) across beta; naturality of the shift comparison of H moves the shifted structure map. The shift equation of beta then identifies the middle factors. Shift the equation at N and use naturality of the shift comparison of R at alpha_N inverse. Associativity and inverse-isomorphism cancellation finish the equality. Simplifying the additive-homomorphism definitions gives the stated theorem.

theorem cyclicDerivedHomTransport_exact_action
    (M N : DerivedCategory (IsoAlgebra F)) (r : ℤ)
    (u : CyclicDerivedHom F M N r) :
    cyclicDerivedHomTransport F G (mapOfNatIso e).mapDerivedCategory
      L.mapDerivedCategory (fun r ↦ L.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso r)
      (cyclicDerivedExactForgetComparison F G L e) M N r
      (cyclicDerivedHomAction F M N r u) =
      cyclicDerivedHomAction G ((mapOfNatIso e).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)
        ((mapOfNatIso e).mapDerivedCategory.obj N) r
        (cyclicDerivedHomTransport F G (mapOfNatIso e).mapDerivedCategory
          L.mapDerivedCategory (fun r ↦ L.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso r)
          (cyclicDerivedExactForgetComparison F G L e) M N r u)
